subject: revenuesystem.android.functional_parity
summary: Owner requests adding a full-feature Android application to المطابقة and reviewing product concept, workflows and programming through المرتكز, Studio and Council perspectives.

details.owner_requirement: Android has the same business capabilities, advantages and operating rules as the desktop application; adapt interaction to mobile.
details.review_status: Initial source-scoped architecture and workflow review; two independent advisory reviewers in this session, not execution of installed Council/Studio runtimes.
details.implementation_status: Not implemented. No product code or operational data changed.

proposed_not_owner_approved.architecture: Shared financial rules and authoritative application API for Windows and Android; no direct mobile SQL/file access.
proposed_not_owner_approved.android_framework: MAUI first candidate, compare against a native alternative using real RTL/input/reporting/device evidence before selection.
proposed_not_owner_approved.offline: Initial cached reads and clearly labelled drafts; financial commits require server confirmation.
controls: financial totals recalculated and validated server-side
proposed_not_owner_approved.parity: Revenue entry, matching, imports, accounts, advances, reports, administration; hardware interfaces require verified adapters.
proposed_not_owner_approved.reuse_gate: Research maintained open-source implementations and specialist evidence before custom code; assess licenses and compatibility.
